visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair and bangs stands in a bright, white-walled room with wooden floors. She is wearing an oversized red, white, and black racing jacket as a dress, paired with chunky black ankle boots. She gestures toward her outfit and poses confidently, showing the front and back of the jacket while a full-length mirror and a scale are visible behind her. (2) The scene transitions as the woman changes into a smaller, black-and-white racing jacket. She wears it open over a black strapless crop top featuring white text and baggy black cargo pants. She carries a black shoulder bag and later puts on a black baseball cap, adjusting her hair and smiling at the camera. (3) She demonstrates a cropped look by tucking the hem of the black-and-white jacket upward, exposing her midriff and waist area. She poses with her hands in her pockets and turns slightly to show the silhouette. The lighting remains bright and even throughout the indoor setting. (4) In the final phase, she styles the same jacket with a white ruffled mini skirt and black boots. She wears clear-framed glasses and performs a series of rhythmic hand gestures and poses, waving goodbye to the camera with four fingers up at the very end.
